notes: Source: 2026 Atlanta Falcons Media Guide, RECORDS & RESULTS > INDIVIDUAL RECORDS pp. 228-237 (PDF page = printed page number). One column per category; each shows 5 rows for career/season/game; lists are ranked by exactly the stat, so all kind=list.

through_season 2025: the lists contain 2025 entries (Bijan Robinson 12/29/25, Zane Gonzalez 11/23/25, Kyle Pitts Sr. 12/11/25, Xavier Watts 12/29/25, Matt Ryan career 2008-21, Younghoe Koo 2019-25) and a p233 punting row dated 01/04/26 (a January 2026 game, i.e. still the 2025 season).

The guide prints no rank numbers; ranks follow printed order (best first) and tied values share the lowest rank (1,1,3,...); tie=true on every tied row. Game dates are printed M/D/YY and are shown here as MM/DD/YYYY (YY 00-26 read as 20YY, else 19YY).

Lines such as '3 - 10 times, Last Tevin Coleman at NO (09/26/16)' name only the latest of several equal performances; they are not copied as rows, except where the whole game list is that single line (rec_td game, int game): there one row for the named latest holder is given with tie=true and uncertain=true.
The guide spells 'Steve Bartowski' on the 1981 season TD-pass row (p231); name copied as printed. Career lists print 'Mike Vick' (not Michael).
Season sacks tie at 13.0 (John Abraham 2010 / Patrick Kerney 2004) and game sacks list prints 'Claude Humphrey (Twice)' for a second 5-sack game without dates.
Tackles: no record list in the guide for any scope; those three pairs are 'missing'.
